enable_history_message_chunking.description: Enable chunking for long history messages before they are exposed by this plugin.

history_message_chunk_length.description: Maximum number of characters per history chunk when chunking is enabled.

enable_history_read_tool.description: Expose the read_current_history LLM tool for the current session.

history_read_tool_default_count.description: Default number of history entries the LLM history tool should read per page.
